content.short: Switchboard provides a multichain oracle for general data feeds and verifiable random function (VRF).
content.description: Switchboard is a multichain oracle that provides on-chain data feeds and verifiable random function (VRF) capabilities. It supports use cases such as determining the current price of an asset for collateralized lending, tracking the state of a tracking number to auto-settle funds on arrival, and ranking fantasy sports standings. The system is permissionless, enabling developers to create and manage their own data feeds across the supported chains, all accessed through Switchboard's interface.
